context:
Reuse the established correctness-gate policy the parent's exclusion mirrors —
derive expectations from the seed's parameters instead of excluding. Small,
additive change to the validation path, guarded by a wrong-seed regression
test.
description:
Promoted from the deferred item in
[[tpch-throughput-seed-validation-fix]] (surfaced by the UAT-effort
assessment, 2026-07-16). The seed-validation fix currently EXCLUDES Q11,
Q16, Q18, and Q20 from row-count validation because their result cardinality
depends on the substitution parameters (the seed), and a single fixed
expectation would be wrong for a different seed. Excluding them unblocks the
gate but leaves four queries unvalidated for row count.

This item closes that hole by deriving the expected row count PER SEED rather
than excluding the query — computing the parameter-aware answer-set
cardinality for the seed in use, so Q11/16/18/20 are validated like the rest.

Gated on the parent because the exclusion lives in the parent's validation
path; this strengthening only makes sense once that path exists and is green.

anti_patterns.dont: simply widen the row-count tolerance to make Q11/16/18/20 pass
anti_patterns.why: that defeats the validation; expectations must be seed-derived and exact.

deferrals.reason: TPC-H Q11/16/18/20 is the concrete gap the parent left; a general framework is a larger design not required to close it.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] conditional-unmet: Generalizing per-seed cardinality derivation to TPC-DS is explicitly a larger framework not required to close the parent gap; parent item is itself still open/planning.
deferrals.summary: Generalise per-seed cardinality derivation to other benchmarks (TPC-DS parameterised queries)

item_meta.blocked_reason: Superseded by the validated bounded-RANGE policy in tpch-throughput-rowcount-validation-range-mode; do not implement exact per-seed validation in parallel. Reopen only if new evidence shows RANGE is insufficient.

preserves.behavior: Non-parameterised queries keep their existing fixed expected row counts unchanged.
The gate stays green for the correct seed and fails for an incorrect expectation (no silent re-widening to always-pass).

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest -k 'throughput and (q11 or q16 or q18 or q20 or rowcount)' -q
verifications.description: Q11/16/18/20 validated (not excluded) and wrong-seed fails
verifications.expected: the four queries are validated per-seed; a wrong-seed expectation fails

work_units.notes:
Confirm Q11/16/18/20 are still excluded post-parent, and find where the
substitution parameters for a seed are available (dsqgen/qgen inputs or
the stored query parameters) so expected cardinality can be derived.
work_units.summary: Re-validate the exclusion is still in place and locate the seed→parameter derivation

work_units.notes:
Compute the parameter-aware expected cardinality for each of the four
queries from the seed's parameters (reference-answer computation), rather
than a fixed literal. Mirror the existing correctness-gate derivation
approach if one exists.
work_units.summary: Derive per-seed expected row counts for Q11/16/18/20

work_units.notes:
Remove Q11/16/18/20 from the exclusion set, wire in the derived
expectations, and add a test that a wrong-seed expectation fails (proving
the validation is parameter-aware, not re-widened to always-pass).
work_units.summary: Replace the exclusion with the derived validation and add regression coverage
